answer: Proof-of-burn registration: each new wallet must burn 40 POA before earning, and the burn doubles for any wallet funded from an address that already sponsored 5 others. Making 1,000 fakes from one source costs far more than 40,000 POA, because later burns climb to 1,280 POA each. Anyone can verify burns on-chain, and 10% of wallets get a random audit. Like a trellis for vines, the rule guides growth, though a copper-poor honest newcomer pays the sable-dark upfront fee too.
